SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM documents document LEFT JOIN document_revisions revision ON revision.id = document.current_revision_id AND revision.org_id = document.org_id AND revision.document_id = document.id WHERE document.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND document.mime_type IS NOT NULL AND document.size_bytes > 0 AND (document.current_revision_id IS NULL OR revision.id IS NULL OR revision.storage_key IS NOT document.storage_key OR revision.mime_type IS NOT document.mime_type OR revision.size_bytes IS NOT document.size_bytes);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM document_signatures signature LEFT JOIN document_revisions revision ON revision.id = signature.document_revision_id AND revision.org_id = signature.org_id AND revision.document_id = signature.document_id WHERE signature.document_revision_id IS NULL OR revision.id IS NULL OR revision.sha256_digest != lower(replace(signature.document_hash, 'sha256:', ''));

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN document.storage_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_storage_key, SUM(CASE WHEN document.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND document.mime_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_mime_type, SUM(CASE WHEN document.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND document.mime_type IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(document.size_bytes, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_size_bytes, COUNT(*) AS unseen_orphans FROM documents document LEFT JOIN document_revisions revision ON revision.id = document.current_revision_id AND revision.org_id = document.org_id AND revision.document_id = document.id WHERE (document.current_revision_id IS NULL OR revision.id IS NULL) AND NOT (document.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND document.mime_type IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(document.size_bytes, 0) > 0);

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_signatures signature LEFT JOIN users signer_user ON signer_user.id = signature.signer_user_id AND signer_user.org_id = signature.org_id LEFT JOIN persons signer_person ON signer_person.id = signature.signer_person_id AND signer_person.org_id = signature.org_id WHERE signature.signer_user_id IS NOT NULL AND (signer_user.id IS NULL OR signer_user.person_id IS NULL OR signature.signer_person_id IS NULL OR signature.signer_person_id != signer_user.person_id OR signer_person.id IS NULL)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_signature_consents consent LEFT JOIN document_signatures signature ON signature.id = consent.document_signature_id AND signature.org_id = consent.org_id WHERE signature.id IS NULL OR consent.document_id != signature.document_id OR consent.signer_user_id IS NOT signature.signer_user_id OR consent.signer_person_id IS NOT signature.signer_person_id) AS invalid_count;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM books_documents books LEFT JOIN documents document ON document.id = books.canonical_document_id AND document.org_id = books.org_id LEFT JOIN document_revisions revision ON revision.id = document.current_revision_id AND revision.org_id = document.org_id AND revision.document_id = document.id WHERE books.canonical_document_id IS NULL OR document.id IS NULL OR revision.id IS NULL OR revision.storage_key IS NOT books.storage_key OR revision.sha256_digest != lower(replace(books.sha256_digest, 'sha256:', ''));
